name: abi-decode
desc: decode Solidity ABI calldata, returndata, revert data or event logs, offline

name: abi-encode
desc: Solidity ABI-encode calldata (selector + args) or a bare type list, offline

name: abi-inspect
desc: list an ABI's functions, events and errors with selectors/topics

name: acct-tx
desc: account-model payments for xlm, algo and atom. Encoded transactions are base64 (each chain's native form)

name: armory-read
desc: Armory (PyBtcWallet) `.wallet` -> {"wif","chain_index"} per stored address

name: bip38-open
desc: BIP38 encrypted private key + passphrase -> WIF

name: blockchain-read
desc: Blockchain.com wallet.aes.json (v2/v3) + password -> wif / xprv lines

name: blocktools
desc: host wrapper that runs a pipeline in the sealed container

name: bytecode-inspect
desc: classify runtime bytecode (EIP-1167 proxy, EIP-7702 delegation, EOF, plain code)

name: chain-table
desc: print the chain registry as data

name: classify
desc: unknown wallet material -> public JSON lines

name: create-address
desc: contract address from CREATE (deployer, nonce) or CREATE2 (EIP-1014: deployer, salt, init code), offline

name: dat-read
desc: Bitcoin Core wallet.dat (legacy Berkeley DB or SQLite descriptor)

name: derive
desc: master key -> child keys and addresses

name: electrum-read
desc: Electrum wallet file (JSON, optionally field-encrypted, or BIE1 whole-file encrypted) -> its seed phrase

name: key-to-addresses
desc: one raw 32-byte private key per line -> addresses on every chain

name: keystore-open
desc: Ethereum Web3 Secret Storage v3 or presale (pyethsaletool) JSON + password -> address

name: msg-sign
desc: sign ONE text message after a human reads it and types a code on /dev/tty

name: msg-verify
desc: check a message signature against an address. No keys are read

name: multibit-read
desc: MultiBit Classic .key export or bitcoinj/MultiBit Classic `.wallet` protobuf

name: pw-candidates
desc: expand a token list into password candidates (btcrecover-style)

name: read-file
desc: concatenate files to stdout (like cat), std only

name: recover.sh
desc: unknown wallet file to sweep, with human confirmation at each step

name: redact
desc: stdin raw JSON lines (may contain secrets) -> stdout public lines

name: rpc
desc: pipe filter for node and wallet RPC endpoints (HOST-SIDE, network)

name: sealed-run
desc: the agent-facing boundary. Runs a pipeline of blocktools tools

name: seed-repair
desc: read a (possibly mistyped) BIP39 / Electrum 2.x phrase, print checksum-valid

name: seed-to-master
desc: seed phrase (+ optional passphrase) -> BIP32 master key(s)

name: sig-hash
desc: Solidity function/event/error selector and topic hash, plus reverse lookup against a file you supply

name: sol-tron-tx
desc: build unsigned, decode and verify Solana and Tron transfers

name: tx-broadcast
desc: send ONE already-signed transaction (HOST-SIDE, network)

name: tx-build
desc: build an UNSIGNED transaction offline from files and flags. Never touches the network

name: tx-decode
desc: decode one transaction on stdin (hex/base64 raw tx, PSBT, EVM RLP)

name: tx-envelope
desc: common signing envelope (public half). Reads one JSON object from stdin

name: tx-sign
desc: sign ONE transaction after a human reads its summary and types a code on /dev/tty

name: tx-verify
desc: check a transaction (stdin; any format tx-decode reads) against what you expect

name: typed-data-verify
desc: EIP-712 typed data -> encodeType, domain separator, message hash and digest

name: utxo-fetch
desc: public chain data for addresses -> files tx-build reads (HOST-SIDE, network)

name: xmr-keys
desc: Monero keys from a seed

name: xmr-wallet
desc: host-side driver for a LOCAL monero-wallet-rpc (loopback only; never runs in the sealed image)

name: xpub-addresses
desc: extended public key (xpub/ypub/zpub/tpub..., stdin, one per line) -> watch-only

name: xrp-tx
desc: XRP keys and transactions (public output only)

name: zec-sapling
desc: Zcash Sapling addresses from a BIP39 mnemonic
